From the text, take sample size n = 100 and blue count x = 30, so the sample proportion is p-hat = 30/100 = 0.30. For a 95% confidence interval, use z* = 1.96. Compute the standard error as sqrt(p-hat(1 - p-hat)/n) = sqrt(0.30 * 0.70 / 100), then form p-hat ± z*SE. Round the resulting endpoints to three decimals and report the interval in the form shown by the standard answer.
